unit_safe:
[Unit]
Description=WG Platform (AxiX) Node Server
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
WorkingDirectory=/opt/wg-platform
ExecStart=/usr/bin/node src/server.js
Environment=[redacted]
Restart=always
RestartSec=3
StandardOutput=append:/opt/wg-platform/logs/server.stdout.log
StandardError=append:/opt/wg-platform/logs/server.stderr.log

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
